name: Madhoo
bio: Madhoo is an Indian actress known for her work in Tamil, Hindi, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam films. Born on March 26, 1969, she gained fame for her role in Roja (1992). She made her Hindi debut with Phool Aur Kaante (1991) and appeared in films like Yodha (1992) and Gentleman (1993). After a career break, she returned to acting in films and web series.
